notes:
Passed on the fake backend by python3 -m mhs.driver check (evidence contract_checked, never an MHS-Device level). Model-authored and unreviewed (driver.lock.json authored_by kind model, reviewed_by null); no hardware was attached and no hardware backend was run. The package serves only the single-agent simple.py world named by the first registration, MultiagentSimple-v0: one movable silent agent and one immovable landmark, 5 discrete actions (0 no-op, 1 -x, 2 +x, 3 -y, 4 +y), a 4-value relative observation, the negative squared-distance reward and max_episode_steps 100. DEVIATION FROM THE CARD: both entry symbols (multiagent.envs:SimpleEnv and multiagent.envs:SimpleSpeakerListenerEnv) are only strings in the two gym.register calls in multiagent/__init__.py:9-21; the clone has no multiagent/envs.py at the pinned commit, so those classes do not exist and their registrations cannot be constructed. The package names the class the documented factory actually builds, multiagent.environment:MultiAgentEnv (make_env.py:32-44), so gate G7 reports G7.NOT_AN_ENTRY_SYMBOL. The second registration and the speaker-listener scenario are NOT COVERED; the other scenarios of the clone are not served. The fake backend is the package's pure Python re-implementation of the simple.py world (fake.py), not the upstream environment; gym and numpy are not installed where the gate runs and the clone is never imported, so the upstream sim path (gymnasium.make(env_id)) was not run and the fake was not compared with an upstream run. The fake applies the discrete_action_input=True branch of environment.py:164-167 to the declared Discrete(5) action space (the upstream default is False and expects a 5-element vector), ignores reset options (reset_world has none), returns the Gymnasium reset and step tuple shapes normalized by the bridge, draws from Python's random.Random instead of numpy's global generator, returns Python floats instead of float32 arrays, and has no rendering, rigid-body dynamics, friction, contacts (the simple scenario disables collisions), actuator, sensor or noise model, or snapshot/restore. Fidelity is therefore F0 with timestep_ms 100.0, realtime_factor 0, lockstep clock and full reset; the gaps list all differences. Expected warnings in the last run: G6.NO_NATIVE_CALL for cap.world.seed.v1 (the bridge records the seed for the next reset and makes no native call), G7.NOT_AN_ENTRY_SYMBOL for the deviation above, and four G8.NO_UNIT for ticks, action.index and seed twice, all bridge-derived integer inputs. There were no G4.REF_VALUE or G4.REF_BINARY warnings. Only catalogue classes cap.world.reset.v1, cap.world.step.v1 and cap.world.seed.v1 are used, so there are no catalogue_requests and no extension ids. No site-limits.example.json: the driver declares no operator-required bound. gate.digest is the digest the last check printed (the report without its clock); check-report.json is regenerated by every gate run and is not part of the package.
